title: Design: long tier names in the archive and Set Rule dialogs
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a long name with spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Pricing Tier).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a long name with no spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingTierPlanX).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>).
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open tier A's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Archive.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. Open tier B's three-dot menu.
  6. Click Archive.
  7. Click Cancel.
  8. Click tier C's row.
  9. Check matrix A.
  10. Type 10 in the bar's value.
  11. Click Set Rule.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The dialog title shows "Archive" with tier A's name and "?" inside the dialog, wrapped if needed.
  • Cancel and Archive stay visible.

Step 4:

  • The dialog closes.

Step 5:

  • The menu opens.

Step 6:

  • The dialog title shows "Archive" with tier B's name and "?", inside the dialog.
  • The text and the Cancel and Archive buttons stay visible inside the dialog; nothing runs past its edges.

Step 7:

  • The dialog closes.

Step 8:

  • Tier C's page opens.

Step 9:

  • The bar reads "Set" tier C's name character for character as typed and "to", with the picker, value and Set Rule still visible.

Step 10:

  • The value reads 10.

Step 11:

  • The dialog title and sentence show tier C's name character for character as typed, & " ' < > included, with Cancel and Set Rule visible.
